prompt.text: Read calc.py and tell me in one sentence what bug it has. Do not edit anything.

content.text: Read calc.py and tell me in one sentence what bug it has. Do not edit anything.

In [calc.py](file:///Users/demo/code/splash-demo/calc.py#L2), `average` subtracts 1 from the true mean because `- 1` binds after the division, so `average([2, 4, 6])` returns `3.0` instead of `4.0` (it also raises `ZeroDivisionError` on an empty list).
